extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, practitioners, and KIPO examiners (Korean jurisdiction)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and examination standards governing filing, formality, substantive requirements, timing, amendments, priority/disclosure claims, and effects for divisional and converted (utility-model→patent) applications before KIPO. Guidance covers when retroactive filing dates apply and examiner procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parent-application amendment to differentiate
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant is supposed to amend the parent application to differentiate the invention described in the claims of the parent application from the claims of the divisional application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: However, the parent application need not be amended if inventions described in the claims of a divisional application are disclosed only in the description of the invention or drawing(s) in the parent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure-exception and priority claim timing for division
rubrics_metrics.description: If a claim regarding disclosure exception or a priority claim is to be made for a divisional application, the applicant shall state the purport of the divisional application and submit the documents needed for such claims by the prescribed date from the filing date of the divisional application (within thirty days for disclosure-exception claims; within three months for priority claims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where a claim for disclosure exception or priority was not made at the time of filing the parent application, such claims shall not be recognized at the filing time of the divisional application. Exception: if the purport was set forth in the parent application but evidential documents were not timely submitted, the claim can still be legitimized by submitting evidential documents within the divisional's prescribed period—unless the parent's claim was invalidated before filing the divisional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitution / reliance on evidential documents of parent
rubrics_metrics.description: Where evidential documents were already submitted for the parent application and are identical to those needed for the divisional, the applicant can substitute by stating the purport of using the parent application in the attached documents of the form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If evidential documents were submitted at the parent's filing time and contain the same claim in the divisional, it is deemed the applicant intended to refer to the parent's evidential documents. Nevertheless Article 10(2) Enforcement Rules requires the intention of reference be stated; if not stated and documents not submitted, the examiner will request amendment citing violation of description formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Divisional retains parent's filing date except in specified unfair cases
rubrics_metrics.description: A divisional application shall retain the same filing date as the parent application, but in particular conditions it shall be deemed to be filed when it is actually filed (i.e., will not get the parent's retroactive filing date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of such cases include when the divisional corresponds to 'another application' under Article 29(3) of the Patent Act or a patent application under Article 4(3) of the Utility Model Act, when new subject matter is added to the divisional specification/drawings, or other specific statutory situations (see numbered list ①–④). New subject matter added to the divisional cannot fairly enjoy the parent's filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific conditions denying retroactive filing date for division
rubrics_metrics.description: Enumerated situations where a divisional shall NOT take the parent's filing date and instead be deemed filed on its actual filing date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed conditions include: (①) divisional corresponds to 'another application' under Article 29(3) or to a patent application under Utility Model Act Article 4(3); (②) applicant seeks application of proviso Article 30(1)(1) and must state purport and submit evidential documents; (③) claiming priority under the Treaty—must state purport, country, and date of first filing; (④) claiming domestic priority—must state purport and prior-filed application in the patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formality and eligibility checks for divisional examination
rubrics_metrics.description: On filing a divisional application the examiner shall first examine whether the application fulfills formality requirements for a divisional and whether it was filed by a person eligible for division, within the designated period, and whether the parent application is properly stated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a divisional was filed by an ineligible person, filed after the designated period, or filed after termination of the parent's pendency, it is deemed a violation of Article 11(1)(7) or (11) and the examiner shall give opportunity to explain; if the applicant cannot explain within the designated period, the written divisional will be returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limits on amendments to divisional while pending
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to a divisional application are allowed only while the divisional is pending and shall be limited to correcting obvious errors or deficiencies; amendments changing the contents of the divisional shall not be accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examiner shall notify applicant of the scope allowed for amendment in the amendment request form; if necessary, state the allowed amendment scope explicitly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of divisional scope based on filing date (time-dependent rules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examinations on the scope of a divisional application shall be conducted based on the filing date, but the applicable procedure differs depending on whether the parent was filed before Sept 30, 2006 or on/after Oct 1, 2006.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If parent filed before Sept 30, 2006 and divisional claims an invention not described in parent, the examiner issues a preliminary notice for inadmissible division and may examine based on actual divisional filing date if division not accepted; published patent gazette of parent can be used as prior art. If parent filed on/after Oct 1, 2006, examiner shall notify grounds for rejection and decide to reject if not remedied. If non-described inventions are deleted by amendment during examination, examiner shall examine based on parent's filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments to specification/drawings in divisional: statutory time limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Amendments to the specification or drawings in a divisional application are allowed only within the period prescribed in the subparagraphs of Article 47(1) of the Patent Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a divisional fulfills procedural and substantive requirements, examiner treats it as a regular application and assesses permissibility of amendments against the divisional's original specification/drawings; addition of inventions not contained originally triggers prohibition on adding new subject matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority-claim and reference-date rules for nested divisional chains
rubrics_metrics.description: A divisional application may claim priority under the Treaty or domestic priority; reference dates to determine patentability for particular inventions in a chain depend on the filing dates of the relevant prior-filed application that disclosed that invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: a divisional based on an application that itself claimed various earlier filings will retain the filing date of its immediate parent for inventions disclosed therein, but the reference date for each invention is the filing date of the prior-filed application that first disclosed that invention. Article 36(2) applies when the same invention is described in both parent and divisional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of parent's return on divisional filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: Where the parent application was pending at the time of filing a divisional but was returned after filing the divisional, the divisional shall not retain the parent's filing date and will be examined based on the actual filing date of the divisional.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a divisional has grounds for rejection, examiner shall notify the applicant of the reason why the divisional cannot take the retroactive filing date along with grounds for rejection; notification uses EDMS (On-nara) in Korean.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on multiple-parent divisional basis
rubrics_metrics.description: A divisional application shall not be filed based on multiple parent applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exception: a divisional can be filed based on a parent application that claims domestic priorities from two or more prior-filed applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special handling when parent has decision to grant (post-29 July 2015)
rubrics_metrics.description: When examining a divisional from a parent which received a certified copy of a decision to grant on or after 29 July 2015, examiners should note special conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If applicant did not request a trial for correction when filing a divisional for an invention disclosed only in the description or for inventions recited in parent's claims, examiners should check whether divisional claimed inventions are identical to those of parent and inform applicant of conflicting application when sending a rejection. If applicant divides part of an invention described in the granted parent while requesting trial for correction, examination of the divisional should be deferred until trial concludes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion allowed only within original disclosure (substantive requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: A converted application (utility model → patent) shall be within the scope of the disclosure in the original specification or drawings of the utility model application; matters disclosed in the converted application must be included in the original specification/drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If even a single matter disclosed in the converted application is not contained in the original specification/drawings, the converted application is illegitimate and has grounds for rejection. Determination uses criteria of explicit description or disclosure understandable without explicit description; refer to 'Scope of Amendment' for methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and eligibility for conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: Conversion from a utility-model registration application to a patent application is allowed within the statutory period (variously: between filing of original and registration, within 30 days from receipt of first certified copy of decision to reject, subject to extensions under specified provisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions: not allowed if 30 days have passed from decision to reject (subject to extension rules), or if original filed in foreign language and required Korean translation not submitted on filing the conversion. For international applications, payment of fees and submission of required translations may be prerequisites to conversion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Converted-application formality: statement of intention & original application
rubrics_metrics.description: A person who intends to file a converted application shall state his/her intention and indicate the application for registration of the utility model to be converted in the patent application; if the original application is not stated or incorrectly stated, conversion is not legitimate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amendments to change the indicated original application are not accepted except to correct explicit errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims for disclosure exception/priority in converted applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Where a converted application claims disclosure exceptions or priority, the applicant shall describe the purport of such claims in the converted application and submit evidential documents within the prescribed period from the filing date of the converted application (30 days for disclosure-exception; three months for priority).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such claims are not accepted if they were not made at time of filing the original application (with limited exceptions for applications filed on/after 29 July 2015). If evidential documents were previously submitted for the original application, the applicant may state reliance on those documents in the converted application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of conversion on original application status
rubrics_metrics.description: When a converted application is filed, the application for registration of the utility model shall be deemed withdrawn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After the original is deemed withdrawn because of conversion, the original shall not be valid even if the converted application is invalidated/withdrawn/rejected, unless the converted application is returned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formality and eligibility checks for converted application
rubrics_metrics.description: Once a converted application is submitted, the examiner shall examine whether it fulfills formality requirements of conversion, whether the person eligible filed it, whether it was submitted within allowed period, and whether the original application is properly stated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If issues (ineligible filer, late submission, original improperly stated, or conversion filed after termination of original procedure) arise, examiner provides opportunity to explain; failure to explain within designated time may result in return of the converted application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time-based examination rules for conversion (pre/post cutoff dates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Examination of converted applications is categorized by time of filing the original application (examples: before July 1, 1999; on/after Oct 1, 2006) and triggers different procedures when inventions not described in original are claimed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If original filed before cutoff and converted claims invention not described in original, examiner delivers preliminary notice for inadmissible conversion and may examine on actual filing date if conversion unacceptable; published gazette on original can be cited as prior art. If original filed on/after cutoff, examiner notifies ground for rejection and may reject if not remedied. Deletion by amendment of non-described inventions during exam can allow retroactive filing date to be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment period for converted application retroactive to original filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: The period allowed for amendments to the specification or drawings of a converted application is within the period prescribed in Article 47(1), retroactively counted from the filing date of the original application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If converted fulfills procedural and substantive requirements, examiner treats it as ordinary application and examines amendments accordingly; adding inventions not in the original specification triggers prohibition on new matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion cannot be based on multiple originals (with limited exception)
rubrics_metrics.description: A converted application shall not be filed based on multiple original applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: However, it is possible to file a converted application after an application claiming Domestic Priority has been filed on the basis of the earlier application(s) (i.e., limited domestic-priority-related exceptions exist).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedural interaction of divisional/conversion with appeals and reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: When an applicant files a converted application along with a request for reexamination regarding the rejected original or an appeal against a decision to reject, the examiner shall accept the converted application if the procedure is legitimate in formality terms; examiner conducts examination of converted when a request for examination is made.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As for the reexamination or appeal, the examiner proceeds with respective procedures with the original application deemed withdrawn according to Article 53(4).
